post.description: Signs in with user name and password. Returns an access token and a refresh token. The account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair. A refresh token can only be used once.
Revokes the given refresh token of the current user.

get.description: Returns the profile, organization, department, roles and effective permissions of the signed-in user.

post.description: Changes the password of the signed-in user and signs them out of all devices.
Sends a password reset code to the email if it is the confirmed email of an active account. Always answers 202 with the same body, so it does not reveal which addresses have accounts.
Sets a new password with the code sent by forgot-password, unlocks the account and signs it out of all devices.

get.description: Active staff by gender, and how many joined or left in the current month, quarter or year (in total and step by step). Requires Dashboard.Staff.

get.summary: Get the staff list of the dashboard
get.description: People working here now, page by page: employee code, name and email, position, date of birth and seniority. Requires Dashboard.Staff.
Returns a flat list of departments, optionally filtered by search text and status.
Returns all departments as a tree of parent and sub-departments.
Returns the organization chart: the organization name, every department with its member, sub-department and head counts and its first heads, and the departments the signed-in user belongs to.
Finds departments (by name, translated name or code) and active people (by name, code, email, department or position) for the chart's search box; at most 10 of each.

put.description: Updates a department, including moving it under another parent.

delete.description: Deletes a department that has no sub-departments and no one assigned. The error says whether the people are still working here or have left.

get.description: Lists the people holding a position in the department, highest-ranked first (people without a position last), optionally only those holding the given role.

post.description: Adds people to an active department with the given role. People already in it only take the new role; the others join alongside their other departments, or, with the transfer placement, leave all of them.

put.description: Moves a department, with its sub-departments, under another active department, or to the top level when no parent is given. A department cannot go under itself or one of its own descendants.
Switches a department on or off. It can be switched off only when none of its sub-departments is active, and back on only when its parent is active.
Changes a member's role and job title in the department; a missing position clears the title.

delete.description: Takes a person out of the department. When it was their primary department, their best-ranked remaining one becomes primary.

put.description: Makes the department the person's primary one.

get.description: True when emails (SMTP) and the web app's address are configured; otherwise the invite form is hidden.
Invitations with the given status (Pending, Expired, Accepted, Revoked), newest first. Without a status: pending and expired ones.

post.description: Sends an invitation valid for 2 days. Only the administrator chooses the role (null = default role); others always invite with the default role. 409 with "invitationId" when the address already has an open invitation.
Sends a pending or expired invitation again with a new link, valid for 2 days from now; the old link stops working.

get.description: For the invited person, without signing in. 404 when the link is unknown or used, 410 when it expired or was revoked.

post.description: Creates the account (the invitation's role, the invited address as a confirmed email) and signs in: the same answer as login. 404 / 410 as for the preview.

get.description: Returns the meeting kinds in catalog order; hidden kinds only when includeHidden is true.

post.description: Adds a meeting kind at the end of the catalog.

put.description: Sets the catalog order. The ids must be exactly all the meeting kinds, hidden ones included.
Renames a meeting kind, sets its English name, and hides or shows it.

delete.description: Deletes a meeting kind that no meeting uses; a used kind can only be hidden.

get.description: Returns the organization profile and its heads: the people holding the highest-ranked position.
Returns the days and hours the organization works; only shapes what the calendar shows.
Lists every permission that can be granted to a role, grouped by feature.
Returns job titles ordered by rank (level 1 = highest).

post.description: Creates a job title such as Editor-in-chief or Chairman. Level 1 is the head of the organization.

delete.description: Deletes a position that nobody holds. Deactivate it instead to keep history.

get.description: Returns posts newest first. Pass nextCursor from the previous page as cursor to read the next one.

post.description: Content is sanitized text. Images, videos and attachments must be uploaded first through files; media lists the album in order, with optional captions.

get.description: Posts pinned to the top of the feed right now (at most 3), most recently pinned first. The feed itself leaves them out.

put.description: Only the author can edit. Send the version you started from; if the post changed since, the response is 409.

delete.description: The author, or a user with Posts.Manage, deletes the post with its images and attachments.

put.description: Requires Posts.Manage. Pins until the given time, or until unpinned when until is omitted. At most 3 posts are pinned at once (409).

get.summary: Get who reacted to a post

put.description: One reaction per person (Like, Love, Haha, Wow, Sad, Angry); a new one replaces the previous. Returns the post's reaction counts.

delete.summary: Remove my reaction to a post

post.summary: Upload an image, video or attachment for a post
post.description: Form fields: file, kind (Image | Video | Attachment). Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB. Videos: MP4, WebM or MOV up to 100 MB. Attachments: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, TXT, CSV or ZIP up to 20 MB. Files not used by a post are deleted after 24 hours.

get.summary: Get a post image or attachment
get.description: Attachments are always downloaded; images are shown inline. A file not attached to a post yet is visible only to its uploader.

get.summary: Get a streaming address for an album image or video
get.description: A presigned storage URL valid for one hour, for
Returns a page of profiles of active users, optionally filtered by search text and department.

put.description: Updates phone number, date of birth, gender and hometown of the signed-in user. The email changes through me/email.
Uploads a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 2 MB (form field "file") and returns its URL.

post.description: Sends a verification code to the new email address. The address is saved only after the code is confirmed. A new code can be requested after the returned number of seconds.

put.description: Saves the new email address when the code is correct. A code expires after 10 minutes and is cancelled after 5 wrong attempts.

post.description: Marks the onboarding of a new account as done; it is not shown again. The phone number, date of birth and gender must be saved first through PUT me (each missing one is a validation error on its field). Refused while the password is temporary.

get.description: Returns the avatar image. The URL in a profile carries a version, so the response can be cached.

post.description: Creates a role with a set of permissions. See GET /api/Permissions for valid permission codes.

put.description: Replaces the name, description and permissions of a role. The Administrator role cannot be changed.

delete.description: Deletes a role. Its holders move to replacementRoleId, or to the default role when omitted. The Administrator and the default role cannot be deleted, and nobody can be moved to the Administrator role.

get.description: Returns a page of users, optionally filtered by search text, department, position, role and status.

post.description: Creates an account with a generated temporary password, returned once; its holder must change it at first sign-in. Only the administrator chooses roles: others give the default role.

get.description: A free username for a new person from their full name ("Nguyễn Văn An" gives "an.nv", numbered when taken).

put.description: Updates profile, positions, roles and join date. Leaving and coming back use deactivate and reactivate.
Gives the user a new temporary password (returned once), unlocks the account and signs them out of all devices. The administrator's password cannot be reset this way.
Ends the user's current stay on leftOn (today when omitted), deactivates the account and signs them out of all devices.
Starts a new stay on rejoinedOn (today when omitted) and reactivates the account. Earlier stays are kept.

get.description: Every stay at the company, oldest first; the current one, if any, is last.

put.summary: Correct the dates of a stay
put.description: Changes the join and leave dates of one stay (e.g. an estimated leave date). Stays may not overlap.
